rv.q: Fans of interactive, improvisational theatre will probably love it – the rest of us might not.
‘…Earnest?’ is something very different and I must applaud the creativity and the absolute bravery of Say It Again, Sorry who devised and performed this extraordinary piece.

cn.t: This improvised riff on Wilde divides critics: some find the ensemble's work with unrehearsed audience members brilliantly funny and unmissable, while others see the concept as overdone.
